title: 第7章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇梦里，是一片火海。炙热的火炙烤着四周，浓烟滚滚，呛得她喘不过来气，处于本能，她打开窗子，然后从三楼跳了下去，灼热的风从脸颊呼啸而过，满世界的哭声！凄惨，无助，而她小小的身体连自己都救不了，那一刻，她觉得自己很无能，那个时候，她在渴望着有一个人来，那个人是无所不能的，只要他出现，这大火绝对会被扑灭，满楼里的孤儿也不必被烧死……身体落地，尖锐的疼痛从脚下传来，场景换了，是在法国的街头，深夜，她抱着一岁多的儿子，在寂静的街头跑着，身后是追赶她的人。她的才华从进入大学的第一天便得到了导师的亲睐，难免被人嫉妒。面前无路可走了，而那些人紧紧地围了过来，叶芊沫将儿子牢牢保护在身下，单薄的身体承受着那些人的拳打脚踢。生硬的拳头狠狠地落在身上，她的头撞在了墙上，鲜血从脸上流下来，染红了半张脸，可是她从来没有哭，下唇被牙齿咬破，她死死地承受着这种疼痛。她必须要变得强大起来，这有这样，她才能保护儿子，保护自己，才能无所畏惧，才能不再受伤！身上没有了拳脚，叶芊沫怔怔地转过头，居然看到了欧慕瑄？！他满身的冰冷，如同来自荒野的狼，带着强烈危险的气息，一点一点的靠近他，她不想让他看到她的狼狈，她想要跑，可是身体被禁锢得死死的。他低头，吻住她的唇，在她耳边呵着暖气，轻柔地说，“别怕，没事的。”然后，他加深了那个吻……猛然，叶芊沫从梦中惊醒，梦到那场大火，那些人的追打，这倒是很正常的，这些年，这些噩梦一直缠绕着她，只是为毛要梦到欧慕瑄啊，梦到就梦到吧，为毛还梦到他的吻……呸呸呸，噩梦，这绝对是一个噩梦！外面的天已经亮了，叶芊沫觉得自己绝对睡不着了，躺着也是胡思乱想，不如早早起床。看到精神百倍的妈咪，小奶娃下意识地看了看时间，严重怀疑自家的所有钟表都出错了，七点就起床？这可不像他那一直会懒床的妈咪啊。“妈咪，你是在梦游吗？”正在做早餐的小奶娃，带着可爱的卡通围裙，探出脑袋问正在客厅里晃悠的叶芊沫。“儿子，过来抱抱！”叶芊沫伸开手，做拥抱状，慵懒的语气带着一点撒娇的意味，像一只可爱的小猫咪。小奶娃立刻关火，蹦跶着两个小短腿，扑到亲亲妈咪的怀里，蹭啊蹭，他最爱亲亲妈咪了，怎么表达都觉得不够呢！叶芊沫很享受，按理说，妈咪应该伺候儿子没错，可是自己的儿子已经强大到超出她的保护范围了，人家的孩子两岁的时候还只会蹲在墙角玩泥巴，而自家的小奶娃已经学会了自己穿衣服，自己吃饭。三岁半，已经会在叶芊沫下班回到家的时候，为她奉上一碗热腾腾的面了，现在，更是精通厨艺，水平足以让那些五星级的厨师羞愧！其实最该羞愧的是叶芊沫吧？身为人母，居然让一个五岁的孩子来照顾自己，而且还享受得那么理所应当。“妈咪，你今天好反常哦！”小奶娃亲亲自家妈咪的脸，“有什么好事发生？”“我看起来像是有好事发生的样子吗？”她明明是做了一个超级恶心的梦好不好，虽然是梦，但她还是刷了两次牙，居然被那个妖孽吻……小奶娃很定地点点头，“像，像极了。”妈咪的眼睛很亮，脸颊也粉扑扑的，这绝对是身心愉悦的表现嘛，听佳泞阿姨说，昨天妈咪非常狗血地遇到了欧慕瑄，并且跟他上演了一出好戏，看来，效果不错嘛！“宝贝，这是你的错觉！”叶芊沫捏捏儿子的脸，“别总是一天到晚抱着电脑，小心累坏了眼睛！”“知道了，不过亲亲妈咪，”小奶娃一脸的奸诈，“听说欧氏集团的网络安全系统是由欧慕瑄亲自设计的，牢不可破哦！”看到儿子这样的表情，叶芊沫就猜到儿子要做什么，“你该不会是想要……”想要黑了人家吧？小奶娃点点头，“亲亲妈咪，你家宝贝手痒了嘛！”想起欧慕瑄那张欠揍的妖孽脸，叶芊沫一脸的阴笑，“老娘准了！”“多谢母亲大人开恩！”小奶娃是电脑天才，这点叶芊沫知道，但儿子喜欢四处挑战人家的防御系统，这点，叶芊沫是前不久的时候才发现的。他们还在巴黎，有一位当地的官员想要占叶芊沫的便宜，此时传到小奶娃的耳朵里，他当晚就摧毁了人家的网络防御系统，毁了人家多个重要文件。虽然儿子一再保证他们查不到是谁，可是叶芊沫还是觉得担忧，于是禁止儿子再去挑衅，而小奶娃自从答应了妈咪之后，就真的再也没有黑过谁，不过今天，他看妈咪高兴，所以一时兴起，决定挑战自家爹地。欧氏大厦，总裁办公室内，冷气开得很大，致使原本就宽大的空间此时变成了一个打冰窟。而黑色的大理石办公桌后，欧慕瑄静静地坐着，身体微微仰靠在椅背上，修长的身体透出一种不容任何人侵犯的威严，如君临天下的帝王，五官刚毅而绝美。身体一动不动，琥珀色的眸子此刻正认真地看着一旁墙上垂下的屏幕，而屏幕上，正播着一次时装展。这是最近在法国举办的一次最有影响力的时装展，世界各地的设计师们都迫不及待地一一在上面展示自己最傲人的作品。他对时装并不感兴趣，欧氏名下的时装产业已经明显拖了后腿，原本他打算在这次的改革中将这个行业去掉的，但是现在，他觉得，也许还可以再试试。想起那个女人嚣张的脸，以及她在设计衣服时，脸上的专注，欧慕瑄觉得，也许她会带领欧氏名下的女装业打入国际市场。一个个身材高挑的模特穿着风格各异的衣服从T台上走过，欧慕瑄看了很久，有些厌了，于是拿起遥控器，打算关掉，然而这时，一件白色的礼服突然出现在他的视野里。纯白的布料，没有夸张的造型，没有璀璨的珠宝，但却显得那么耀眼，明明是简约的设计，竟然会有一种力量感，充分彰显了一个女人的高贵，而明明是这么的不可侵犯，给人的感觉，却不是疏离，而是想要去征服！这款设计，让欧慕瑄原本疲惫的视觉重新振作起来，莫名的，他突然很想找到这个设计师！
content_en: Chapter 1: Meeting in a bar. In the dream, there was a sea of ​​fire. The scorching fire was scorching the surroundings, and the smoke was billowing, making her unable to breathe. Instinctively, she opened the window and jumped from the third floor. The scorching wind whizzed past her cheeks, and cries filled the world! Miserable, helpless, and her little body couldn't even save herself. At that moment, she felt incompetent. At that time, she was longing for someone to come. That person was omnipotent. As long as he appeared, the fire would definitely be extinguished, and the orphans in the building would not be burned to death... The body fell to the ground, and sharp pain came from under her feet. The scene changed. It was on the streets of France. Late at night, she was holding her one-year-old son, running on the quiet street, with people chasing her behind her. Her talent was favored by her tutor from the first day she entered university, and it was inevitable that she would be envied by others. There was no way out in front of him, and those people surrounded him tightly. Ye Qianmo protected her son tightly under her body, and her thin body withstood the punches and kicks of those people. A blunt fist fell hard on her body, and her head hit the wall. Blood flowed from her face, staining half of her face red, but she never cried. Her lower lip was bitten by her teeth, and she endured the pain. She must become stronger. Only in this way can she protect her son and herself, be fearless, and no longer get hurt! Without her fists and legs, Ye Qianmo turned her head in confusion and saw Ou Muxuan? ! His whole body was cold, like a wolf from the wilderness, with a strong and dangerous aura. She was getting closer to him little by little. She didn't want him to see her embarrassment. She wanted to run, but her body was tightly restrained. He lowered his head, kissed her lips, breathed warmth into her ear, and said softly, "Don't be afraid, it's okay." Then, he deepened the kiss...Suddenly, Ye Qianmo woke up from her dream, dreaming of the fire and the pursuit of those people. Fighting, this is normal. These nightmares have been haunting her all these years, just why Mao wants to dream about Ou Muchuan, just dream about it, why Mao also dreams about his kiss... Bah, bah, bah, nightmare, this is definitely a nightmare! It was already dawn outside, and Ye Qianmo felt that she would never be able to sleep. She would just be thinking wildly while lying down, so it was better to get up early. Seeing his energetic mother, the little baby subconsciously checked the time. He seriously suspected that all the clocks in his house were wrong. He got up at seven o'clock? This is not like his mother who is always lazy in bed. "Mommy, are you sleepwalking?" The little baby girl who was making breakfast, wearing a cute cartoon apron, stuck her head out and asked Ye Qianmo, who was wandering around the living room. "Son, come here and give me a hug!" Ye Qianmo stretched out her hands as if to hug her. Her lazy tone was a bit coquettish, like a cute kitten. The little baby boy immediately turned off the heat, jumped up and down with his two short legs, and threw himself into Mommy Kiss's arms, rubbing and rubbing against him. He loved Mommy Kiss the most, and he couldn't express it enough! Ye Qianmo enjoyed it very much. Logically speaking, mommy should serve her son, but her son was already too powerful to protect her. When her child was two years old, she could only squat in the corner and play with mud, but her little baby had already learned to dress and eat by herself. At the age of three and a half, he can already serve Ye Qianmo a bowl of hot noodles when she comes home from get off work. Now, he is even more proficient in cooking, with a level that would put even five-star chefs to shame! In fact, the one who should be ashamed the most is Ye Qianmo, right? As a mother, she actually lets a five-year-old child take care of her, and she enjoys it so naturally. "Mommy, you are so weird today!" The little baby kissed Mommy's face, "What good thing happened?" "Does it look like something good happened to me?" She must have had a super disgusting dream, okay? Even though it was a dream, she still brushed her teeth twice, and she was actually killed by that monster Kiss... The little baby nodded firmly, "It's very similar." Mommy's eyes were very bright and her cheeks were pink. This was definitely a sign of physical and mental happiness. Aunt Jia Ning said that yesterday, Mommy met Ou Muchuan in a very bloody way and put on a good show with him. It seems that the effect was good! "Baby, this is your illusion!" Ye Qianmo pinched her son's face, "Don't hold the computer all day long, be careful of getting tired of your eyes!" "I know, but kiss mommy," the little baby said with a treacherous look on her face, "I heard that the Ou Group's network security system was designed by Ou Muxuan himself and is unbreakable!" Seeing his son's expression, Ye Qianmo guessed what his son was going to do, "Don't you want to..." Want to hack someone else? The little baby nodded, "Kiss mommy, your baby's hands are itchy!" Thinking of Ou Muxuan's monster face that needed a beating, Ye Qianmo smiled sinisterly, "I'm right!" "Thank you, mother, for being so kind!" The baby is a computer genius, Ye Qianmo knew this, but her son liked to challenge other people's defense systems. Ye Qianmo only discovered this not long ago. While they were still in Paris, there was a local official who wanted to take advantage of Ye Qianmo. At this time, the news reached the ears of Little Milkman. He destroyed his network defense system that night and destroyed many of his important documents. Although her son repeatedly promised that they could not find out who it was, Ye Qianmo still felt worried, so she forbade her son from provoking any more provocations. Since the little baby agreed to mommy, he has really never hacked anyone again. But today, he saw that mommy was happy, so he decided to challenge his daddy on a whim. In the CEO's office in Ou's Building, the air conditioner was turned on so much that the originally spacious space turned into an ice cave. Behind the black marble desk, Ou Muchuan sat quietly, leaning slightly on the back of the chair. His slender body exuded a majesty that could not be violated by anyone, like an emperor who ruled the world, with resolute and firm features.
